description: Set persistent collectblock defaults: the chest locations to deposit into when full, and the item filter (depositItems or keepItems) used for those deposits.

chestLocations.description: Chest positions to deposit into when the inventory fills

depositItems.description: Only these item names are moved to a chest (mutually exclusive with keepItems)

keepItems.description: Keep these item names; everything else may be deposited

name: set_collect_config
